LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_1_0.label: Storm network · Awakening
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_1_0.description: Grants 0.65 chain level. Chain hits leave the attacker's storm mark for 8 seconds. A marked enemy's death releases lightning at the nearest 3 enemies within 12 cells, dealing 32.5 + 6.5 × chain level damage. These secondary kills cannot trigger further discharges.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_1_1.label: Heaven's charge · Awakening
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_1_1.description: Every third valid hit strikes the original target for an additional 65 + 65% of this hit's direct damage as lightning damage. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_2_0.label: Forked arc · Specialization
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_2_0.description: A successful attack arcs to up to two nearby enemies for 4% of its damage, capped at 6 each. Cooldown: 4s.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_2_1.label: Focused charge · Specialization
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_2_1.description: Three hits on the same enemy within 5s deal an extra 8% of the last hit, capped at 10. Cooldown: 3s.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_2_2.label: Returning current · Specialization
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_2_2.description: When no other enemy is near the target, a hit grants a shield worth 10% of its damage, capped at 10, for 4s. Cooldown: 5s.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_2_3.label: Conductive escort · Specialization
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_2_3.description: A hit shields the nearest other colonist within 8 cells for 2, lasting 5s. Cooldown: 5s.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_3_0.label: Flowing momentum · Metamorphosis
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_3_0.description: Every 2s, moving at least 3 cells stores 2 charge, up to 10. Your next hit releases 50% of stored charge, capped at 12 together with shield reserves. Cooldown: 6s.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_3_1.label: Shield reservoir · Metamorphosis
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_3_1.description: Store 20% of absorbed hostile damage, up to 10. Your next hit releases 50% of stored charge, capped at 12 together with movement charge. Cooldown: 6s.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_3_2.label: Emergency shelter · Metamorphosis
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_3_2.description: When the nearest other colonist within 8 cells falls below 40% health, grant a 6 shield for 6s. Cooldown: 20s.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_3_3.label: Crown of groves · Metamorphosis
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_3_3.description: After 20s of sowing or harvesting, heal 1.5 treatable injury points on up to three other colonists within 8 cells and grant each a 2.5 shield for 10s. Cooldown: 20s.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_4_0.label: Kindling scar · Convergence
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_4_0.description: A successful attack applies 0.06 burn levels. Cooldown: 5s.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_4_1.label: Ashen mantle · Convergence
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_4_1.description: Your burn damage grants a personal shield worth 30% of the damage, capped at 8, lasting 4s. Cooldown: 5s.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_4_2.label: Shared shelter · Convergence
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_4_2.description: After absorbing an enemy attack, shield the nearest other colonist within 8 cells for 21% of the absorbed damage, capped at 8, for 4s. Cooldown: 6s.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_4_3.label: Retribution oath · Convergence
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_4_3.description: After absorbing an enemy attack, return 18% of the absorbed damage, capped at 8. Cooldown: 5s.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_5_0.label: Crown of storms · Crown
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_5_0.description: Every fourth successful attack strikes up to four enemies within 7 cells of the target for 16% of this hit, capped at 10 each. Cooldown: 10s.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_5_1.label: Crown of embers · Crown
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_5_1.description: Store 20% of actual burn damage as embers, up to 4 per event and 20 total. With at least 8 stored, your next hit releases 80% of the reserve, capped at 16. Cooldown: 8s.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_5_2.label: Crown of oaths · Crown
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_5_2.description: After your shield absorbs 30 hostile damage, heal 4 treatable injury points on the nearest other colonist within 8 cells. Cooldown: 15s.
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_5_3.label: Flowing momentum · Crown
LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Thunder_5_3.description: Every 2s, moving at least 3 cells stores 2 charge, up to 10. Your next hit releases 80% of stored charge, capped at 12 together with shield reserves. Cooldown: 6s.

LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Flame_1_0.description: Grants 0.65 burn level. Once per second, the wearer's burn can spread a level-0.65 burn lasting 4 seconds to the nearest 2 other enemies within 5 cells of its target.

LanguageData.RHA_N29_RHA_Path_Flame_2_2.label: Consume embers · Specialization
